# Custom Intelligence Group

> Custom Intelligence Group (CIG) builds custom AI products for companies across every industry — automations, AI employees, and custom dashboards tailored to how each business actually runs, not generic AI tools or templates.

CIG serves home services, construction, real estate, healthcare, legal, retail & e-commerce, hospitality, professional services, manufacturing, finance, logistics, nonprofit, and other industries. Every engagement starts by learning the client's operations before recommending a solution.

## Services
- Automations: Replacing repetitive, manual, error-prone workflows (quoting, scheduling, follow-ups, data entry, reporting) with automations that run in the background.
- AI Employees: Purpose-built AI agents that answer customers, qualify leads, process documents, and manage inboxes around the clock.
- Custom Dashboards: Centralized, real-time dashboards built from a business's own data so decisions aren't guesses.

## Process
1. Discover — a short guided onboarding to learn the business, its pain points, and its current AI familiarity.
2. Diagnose — analyze workflows to find where automation, an AI employee, or a dashboard will move the needle fastest.
3. Design & Build — a custom solution built specifically around the client's systems, data, and team.
4. Deploy & Support — integration, team training, and ongoing optimization.
